answer: Make sybil rings unstable from the inside. Every agent posts a bond, and any member of a ring can secretly file signed proof that its siblings share one operator, then claim all their bonds. A farm built on a knoll of fake identities stands on a ledge: each puppet is a possible defector, so the operator must trust copies that profit from betrayal. Honest agents lose nothing, while the ring needs basalt-hard secrecy it cannot buy.
